tool.name: Search Room Resources
tool.description: Search pinned room resources + tools + participants for the current room (resolved via env('ROOM_ID') → env('CONVERSATION_ID')). Uses Starships connector action `get-room-resources`. Returns lean { pins, tools, participants } (no ids; agents include role).

q.description: Optional search query across name/slug/description of pinned resources

includeArchived.description: Whether to include archived tables/task boards

parameters.name: Starships: Get room resources

nodes.name: Unwrap + shape (lean, no ids, agent role)

parameters.description: Internal: calls Starships connector action `get-room-resources` and shapes a lean payload.
